event.description: Union closest shared FF-output scalar groups 67 and 97
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,588 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 65 prior macro-attempts in this family and 550 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0166/micro-0006 at 1,590 parameters and 99.02%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0167/micro-0001 (FF-output pair 180/59 discarded at 98.96%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the depth-shared feed-forward output map: union flattened coordinates 67 and 97, values 0.0039833756 and 0.0041968096 (difference 2.134e-04), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: residual-stream reconstruction contains near-duplicate scalars distinct from FF-input redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,587 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-output union (difference 2.139e-04) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test of the complementary FF map. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
